title: sieve: RFC 5228 AST type definitions
description: Define the complete AST for RFC 5228 Sieve scripts in crates/sieve/src/ast.rs. Types needed: SieveScript(Vec<Command>); enum Command { If(IfChain), Require(Vec<String>), Stop, Action(Action) }; struct IfChain { condition: Test, then_block: Vec<Command>, elsif: Vec<(Test,Vec<Command>)>, else_block: Option<Vec<Command>> }; enum Test { Address{..}, AllOf(Vec<Test>), AnyOf(Vec<Test>), Envelope{..}, Exists(Vec<String>), False, Header{..}, Not(Box<Test>), Size{over: bool, bytes: u64}, True }; enum Action { Keep, Discard, FileInto(String), Reject(String), Redirect(String) }; enum MatchType { Is, Contains, Matches, Value(RelOp), Count(RelOp) }; enum AddressPart { Localpart, Domain, All }; enum Comparator { AsciiCasemap, OctetBitmap, AsciiNumeric }; enum RelOp { Gt, Lt, Ge, Le, Eq, Ne }. All types derive Debug, Clone, PartialEq. No serde. Placeholders for extension tests (Variables, Date) as variants with todo!() bodies.
